## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Both the autopilot convergence loop and the merge-pull-requests execute_plan...

The system SHALL ensure that both the autopilot convergence loop and the merge-pull-requests execute_plan gate use one shared predicate for unconfirmed high/critical judgment findings, and neither passes such a finding as advisory; each returns adjudication_required instead.

#### Scenario: Both the autopilot convergence loop and the merge-pull-requests execute_plan...

WHEN `add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate` is implemented
THEN Both the autopilot convergence loop and the merge-pull-requests execute_plan gate use one shared predicate for unconfirmed high/critical judgment findings, and neither passes such a finding as advisory; each returns adjudication_required instead.

### Requirement: The orchestrator records a schema-validated verdict per finding (claim...

The system SHALL ensure that the orchestrator records a schema-validated verdict per finding (claim verified, refuted or unverifiable; required file:line evidence for verified and refuted; impact_if_true blocking or non_blocking; calibrated criticality; justification), stamped with adjudicator identity and the reviewed head SHA. A verdict is stale once the head moves.

#### Scenario: The orchestrator records a schema-validated verdict per finding (claim...

WHEN `add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate` is implemented
THEN The orchestrator records a schema-validated verdict per finding (claim verified, refuted or unverifiable; required file:line evidence for verified and refuted; impact_if_true blocking or non_blocking; calibrated criticality; justification), stamped with adjudicator identity and the reviewed head SHA. A verdict is stale once the head moves.

### Requirement: Gate outcomes are computed in code from verdicts: verified plus blocking...

The system SHALL ensure that gate outcomes are computed in code from verdicts: verified plus blocking blocks with a fix hand-off, unverifiable plus blocking routes to the human queue, and refuted or non_blocking passes. Only unverifiable blocking claims reach a human.

#### Scenario: Gate outcomes are computed in code from verdicts: verified plus blocking...

WHEN `add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate` is implemented
THEN Gate outcomes are computed in code from verdicts: verified plus blocking blocks with a fix hand-off, unverifiable plus blocking routes to the human queue, and refuted or non_blocking passes. Only unverifiable blocking claims reach a human.

### Requirement: Adjudication performed by the same vendor family that authored the change is...

The system SHALL ensure that adjudication performed by the same vendor family that authored the change is recorded and flagged in the gate result.

#### Scenario: Adjudication performed by the same vendor family that authored the change is...

WHEN `add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate` is implemented
THEN Adjudication performed by the same vendor family that authored the change is recorded and flagged in the gate result.

### Requirement: A PR #484 replay fixture (7 single-vendor criticals) yields exactly the two...

The system SHALL ensure that a PR #484 replay fixture (7 single-vendor criticals) yields exactly the two verified blocking verdicts.

#### Scenario: A PR #484 replay fixture (7 single-vendor criticals) yields exactly the two...

WHEN `add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate` is implemented
THEN A PR #484 replay fixture (7 single-vendor criticals) yields exactly the two verified blocking verdicts.
